product.name: Tornado V3 Flagship
product.description:
Description
The X-Man Tornado 3x3 V3 Premium, Flagship (Magnetic, Ball-Core, UV Coated) is a top-tier magnetic speed cube designed for fast, stable solves with easy, repeatable tuning. Piece magnets add crisp alignment "clicks," while a ball-core (corner-to-core magnets) boosts stability and controllability so the cube re-aligns cleanly during high-TPS turning. With a durable, high-grip UV coated finish, a modern 55.5 mm size, and tool-free adjustments, it's a strong choice for new solvers who want premium performance and experienced cubers who want consistent, reliable control.

Why you'll like it
  • Stable, controllable turning: Ball-core corner-to-core magnets improve re-alignment and reduce instability.
  • Crisp magnetic accuracy: Piece magnets help layers settle cleanly for fewer overshoots.
  • Tool-free tuning: Dual adjustment system with 8 tension and compression settings—no tool needed.
  • Secure, competition-ready build: Improved magnet slots and stronger core design reduce magnet loss risk.
  • High-grip UV finish: Glossy, durable coating provides confident handling and long-lasting shine.
